title: Behavioral Fingerprinting of Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 超越性能分数刻画模型内在行为风格
contributions.mechanism: 精选诊断提示套件(Diagnostic Prompt Suite)探测四维:世界模型完整性、抽象/元认知推理、人格与偏见(含谄媚)、语义鲁棒性
contributions.evaluation: 作为框架应用于 18 个模型,定性+定量画像(非单一数字)
contributions.domain: LLM 评测 / 行为分析
contributions.source_quote: We design and implement a comprehensive diagnostic suite that probes four key dimensions of LLM behavior.

contributions.purpose: 自动化、可复现地评分行为
contributions.mechanism: 强 LLM 充当公正判官按细则打分 + 类 MBTI 沟通风格刻画法
contributions.evaluation: 产出雷达图指纹与 MBTI 型别表(如 ISTJ/ESTJ),无准确率数字
contributions.source_quote: We pioneer a fully automated evaluation pipeline where a powerful LLM acts as an impartial 'judge' ... a novel method for characterizing a model's communication style using an analogue to the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI).

contributions.purpose: 揭示 LLM 生态的收敛与分化
contributions.mechanism: 18 模型跨能力档对比六维行为分
contributions.evaluation: 核心推理趋同;谄媚抵抗大模型组 1.00(Claude-opus-4.1)→0.25(Grok-4),鲁棒性 1.00→0.50;默认人格聚集于 ISTJ/ESTJ
contributions.source_quote: while core capabilities like abstract and causal reasoning are converging among top models, alignment-related behaviors such as sycophancy and semantic robustness vary dramatically.

self_declared_provenance.quote: a novel method for characterizing a model's communication style using an analogue to the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI).
We complement these by focusing on how models behave.

notes: 3 条编号贡献,method/finding/resource 三型齐备。方法学疑点:单一 LLM-as-judge 打分未报人类校验或判官间一致性;类 MBTI 映射缺乏心理测量学依据(伪科学风险);行为分多为单次评测无置信区间。发现有具体范围数字(谄媚 1.00→0.25、鲁棒 1.00→0.50)。第一作者署名 Gemini-2.5-Pro(AI 共作)。四元组适配良好。
